run_experiment_status: run the status command to show experiment status including iteration, baseline, and best run
parse_args_workdir: parse command line arguments to extract the workdir path for experiment status display
failure_summary_tree: generate a failure summary by reading engine tree.json and listing all failed nodes with job details
setup_failure_lines: read setup_failures.json from the engine directory and format setup failure lines with kind and message
node_message_retry: extract node failure message including retry attempt details from the node spec and failure dict
